amendments.issue: API host unreachable directly; existing proxy environment was absent in noninteractive shell
amendments.action: Use existing localhost HTTP proxy :7892 per command; direct/public TCP tests and two successful proxy model probes retained. No system configuration or credentials changed.

amendments.issue: Full-timeline and large screening calls can exceed 180 seconds
amendments.action: v1.1 raises timeout to300s and queue worker cap to8; original failed attempts retained.

amendments.issue: Adjacent distinct training days were automatically merged by inherited temporal rule in888-1
amendments.action: v1.2 retains adjacent cores for semantic audit, uses half-open frame bounds, requires overlap revision. Same-episode steps still cannot be split. Preserved old result and reran; final source validation replays legacy closed-core requests exactly for unaffected legacy cases.

amendments.issue: Locator enumerated every subtitle of whole chapters and included some out-of-video trailing subtitles
amendments.action: Require minimal evidentiary cores and direct source anchor IDs. All captions remain input unchanged; malformed bounds cannot pass; failed791-3 archived and rerun.

amendments.issue: JSON root sometimes a single-object array or flat facts array
amendments.action: Explicit object-root instructions; only a one-object wrapper can be losslessly normalized with raw response retained. Incomplete flat fact arrays still fail or require schema repair.

amendments.issue: Question-only model sometimes assigned highest priority to negative/exhaustive news questions
amendments.action: Prioritize positive order/sequence/cross-episode comparison candidates rated>=3, then other positive candidates, then remaining candidates. Does not alter acceptance. Every asynchronous draw wave is frozen for exact replay.

amendments.issue: Initial consumer filename shadowed standard-library queue
amendments.action: Renamed toconsume.py before it submitted any question; startup failure log preserved.

amendments.issue: Several large non-streaming requests exceeded read timeout repeatedly
amendments.action: v1.3 uses streamed responses with final JSON/finish reason/usage recorded; successful transport probe archived. Timeout attempts have unknown provider-side token usage and are not counted as zero cost.

amendments.issue: Incorrect localization anchor IDs and subtitle boundary expansion created artificial overlapping cores
amendments.action: v1.4 retains proposed nonoverlapping half-open cores unchanged, logs invalid localization anchors removed, and retains full original source bank. Actual verification sees original core frames/subtitles. Raw proposals and superseded sources remain archived.

amendments.issue: Minimal rubric still sometimes added unasked numeric ranks/exact timestamps; compound sequence/shared-equipment claims were accepted despite missing middle events or days
amendments.action: v1.5 derives adjacent relation facts deterministically for original labeled order questions. Root source review rejects unsupported subset reasoning and refines affected old rubrics, rerunning original-source audit, every singleton/deletion and full-caption countersearch. Shared equipment gets one fact per requested day; no extra uniqueness claim.

amendments.issue: A v1.4 retry launcher overlapped with the producer for624-2/799-2/800-1
amendments.action: Terminated only duplicate retry launcher before any accepted results; retained request copies and incident record under run-001/incidents/retry-v14-concurrent-launch. Producer owns those runs;888-1 was restarted explicitly. Provider usage of aborted duplicates unknown. Future retries reserve IDs first, preserve old results while revalidating, and use per-question fcntl locks.

amendments.issue: 822-1 sampled next independent craft chapter title inside previous core
amendments.action: Root viewed original R019 at1318s; corrected G03 end/G04 start from1320 to1318. Old evidence preserved; revised source projection, answer-blind observation and all subsequent tests must rerun.

amendments.issue: v1.6: continuous activities were proposed as independent evidence groups
amendments.action: Strengthened explicit examples; one ongoing workout, recipe, trick or editing task remains one episode. Added per-day and adjacent-order atomic facts.

amendments.issue: v1.7: relation facts passed despite absent middle entities; contradictory support fields
amendments.action: Require separate endpoint source citations, explicit per-fact statuses and no missing claims on positive results; retain raw responses and bounded repairs. Pool cap32, actual worker count frozen per draw.

amendments.issue: v1.8: concurrent snapshot initialization and media duration beyond final video PTS
amendments.action: Serialize snapshot initialization with a file lock. Decode actual last frame only when within2s of requested time; retain actual PTS. See trailing_frame_check.json; no synthetic timestamp.

amendments.issue: Legacy616-3 negative subset result omitted per-fact status
amendments.action: Offline exporter tolerates only the single-fact explicit-negative response with both overall flags false and nonempty missing evidence; never infers positive support.

amendments.issue: Technical retries, supplemental low-priority questions and source-boundary refinements
amendments.action: Preserve technical_retry_v17.json, supplemental_candidates_v18.json and rubric_refinements including history. Latest822-1 refinement tightens all five craft cores and grounds each endpoint. Formal_order_rubrics.json remains historical v1.5 derivation; actual per-result rubric and snapshot are authoritative.

amendments.issue: User paused due to low efficiency; background results include extensive API connection failures
amendments.action: No local experiment workers remained at pause. Added pause_queue and pause_record.json. Freeze partial export without further API calls; target50 remains unmet. Any future resume needs explicit user instruction and a new execution record.

legacy_result_policy: Preserve all attempts and superseded results; no inherited acceptance from previous experiment; legacy nonoverlapping core inputs replayed with their original boundary semantics.
